headline: Stars’ Esa Lindell out against Bruins with lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Dallas defenseman Esa Lindell will miss the game against the Bruins with a lower-body injury. The veteran has yet to record a point in his eight games this season.

The empty scoresheet says less than it seems to. Lindell has been on the ice for 20.81 minutes a night, and his own expected goals (the quality of the chances he generates) come to 0.23 so far this season, so he has been unlucky more than ineffective. At 5-on-5, DAL has taken 51.8 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team's share runs 3.55 percentage points better when he plays. The Stars are 4-3-1 and have leaned on goaltending, which has saved 9.5 goals above expected, so a thinner blue line matters. Lindell also kills penalties, and DAL's penalty kill is allowing just 0.5 expected goals per game, a unit worth watching. Going by how the coach has used his players, Lian Bichsel (15:27 a night) is next in line for his minutes. BOS, at 7-2-0, is a tough opponent to face short-handed.
